name: marketing-redesign
description: Prospect marketing, build plan § 7e.11 (rulings 104-111 and 117-125, 10-23-26): the Marketing Management redesign's one CRM change. The qualification ladder inside Qualified (CProspect.qualificationLevel, who set it by hand and when), the referrer (a partner link and a free-text name), the reply flag, the lead's conversations (CConversation <-> CProspect, the PARENT_LINKS shape), personal outreach without a campaign (the touch's campaign link optional, two channel options), and the Constant Contact email id on a campaign. Additive only; nothing Read-only (ruling 40: the application writes every one of these under the org-wide API key). CProspect.assignedUser is already enabled on crm-test (read 10-24-26) so the plan does not touch it. Handoff: marketing-redesign-crm-handoff.md.

fields.name: qualificationLevel
fields.label: Level
fields.tooltipText: How far along a Qualified lead is: Identified (a real business, no named person or direct line), Contactable (a named person and a phone or an email), Referred (introduced by a partner or someone trusted, with a phone or an email). Empty unless Lead Status is Qualified. The system places it whenever a fact changes; you may set it by hand; it never moves backwards.

fields.name: levelSetAt
fields.label: Level set by hand at
fields.tooltipText: When a person last set the level by hand. Written by the application with Level set by hand; after this the system moves the level forward only when a new fact (a phone, an email, a named person, a referrer) allows a higher level.

fields.name: referredByName
fields.label: Referred by (name)
fields.tooltipText: Who introduced this lead, when the referrer is not a partner on file. A referrer and a phone or an email make the lead Referred. Use Referred by (partner) for a partner.

fields.name: replied
fields.label: Replied
fields.tooltipText: The lead has written back to a personal email and has not yet been converted. Set by the email sync, cleared by conversion.

fields.name: vendorEmailId
fields.label: Constant Contact email id
fields.tooltipText: The id of the email staff sent in Constant Contact for this campaign, picked in Marketing Management. The send report reads its results by this id. Written by the application.
